## AI-Assisted Deal Flow

```{=html}
<div class="slide-body">
<p class="slide-intro">AI gives deal flow a brain — unified data, faster insight, and prioritized review.</p>
<div class="flow">
  <div class="flow-step">CRM + Harmonic + PitchBook</div><div class="flow-arrow">→</div>
  <div class="flow-step highlight">AI Summaries</div><div class="flow-arrow">→</div>
  <div class="flow-step highlight">Investment Signals</div><div class="flow-arrow">→</div>
  <div class="flow-step highlight-green">Relevance Scoring</div><div class="flow-arrow">→</div>
  <div class="flow-step highlight-purple">Prioritized Deal Flow</div>
</div>
<ul>
  <li>External data unified into one view</li>
  <li>AI distills company narratives in seconds</li>
  <li>Signals surface thesis-fit opportunities automatically</li>
  <li>Partners review the <strong class="metric-sm">best</strong> deals first — not just the loudest</li>
</ul>
<div class="callout callout-purple">AI doesn't replace judgment — it front-loads intelligence so investors spend time where it matters.</div>
</div>
```
